info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Sales Product Retrieval API
info.description: The Sales Product Retrieval API allows consumers to access detailed information about specific sales products within the banking domain. Through this endpoint, users can retrieve data related to a sales product by utilizing its unique identifier. It is primarily designed for business analysts and developers looking to integrate sales data into reporting tools or applications. By leveraging this API, users can enhance their decision-making processes and gain insights into product performance and trends.

get.summary: Retrieve a specific sales product by its ID.
get.description: This endpoint allows you to fetch detailed information about a specific sales product, identified by its unique product ID. It provides all relevant data associated with the product, which can be useful for sales reporting and analysis.

requestBody.description: This request body should contain the necessary parameters to retrieve the sales product details for the specified product ID (PROD-700045). Ensure all required fields are included for a successful operation.
